# Support

Thanks for using Strategos-MCTS. Here is where to get help.

## Documentation first

- **[Documentation index](../docs/README.md)** — the map of all guides, references, and explanations.
- **[Project status](../docs/STATUS.md)** — the reproducible test/coverage baseline (source of truth).
- **[README](../README.md)** — installation, quick start, and feature overview.
- **[Operational runbooks](../docs/runbooks/)** — incident response for high error rate, high latency, and
  service-down scenarios.

## Asking questions and reporting problems

- **Bugs:** open an issue using the **Bug report** template.
- **Feature requests:** open an issue using the **Feature request** template.
- **General questions / usage help:** open a GitHub Discussion if enabled, otherwise a **Feature request**
  issue works.

Before filing, please search existing issues to avoid duplicates, and include your environment (OS, Python
version, installed extras, LLM provider) and any relevant logs.

## Security

Do not use public issues for security reports — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

Want to fix it yourself? See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
